provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Nonadhesive small-strain Hertz spherical contact in series with a linear testing-machine compliance C>=0. Delta_total=(3*F/(4*E_reduced*sqrt(R)))^(2/3)+C*F. Reduced modulus obeys1/E_reduced=(1-nu_specimen^2)/E_specimen+(1-nu_indenter^2)/E_indenter. All loads refer to the same elastic sample state with no contact offset or plasticity.
fit: Fit both independent F^(2/3) and F coefficients without an intercept to all paired observations, then invert the positive Hertz coefficient and subtract the known indenter compliance. No separate machine calibration may be assumed.
scope: Inverse model under the declared ideal contact law, not a general nanoindentation hardness or plastic-contact interpretation.
